**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017), 20 cm refractor for outreach. ~195 useful nights/year; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). ~400 GB/month, transferred nightly to Marseille (40 min).

**Decided:** No runs during outreach evenings (2023 incident). Raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years. Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized, telescope hit dome wall, counterweight rod bent; rod replaced, limit switch added. Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; now GPS-checked each session.

**Planned:** New camera (March 2025), 30% lower read noise; firmware update pending, needs one offline night.

**Open:** Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration; shared scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
